graph_contract.note: End-to-end graph: container-bytes audio decode, log-mel, beam search and BPE detokenize are fused into one ONNX model via ONNX Runtime Extensions custom operators. This is NOT the split encoder/decoder export published by onnx-community/Xenova; those graphs take input_features and emit token ids, and will not satisfy this contract.

acquisition.reason: No public repository publishes this end-to-end artifact. Every HuggingFace whisper-tiny ONNX repo ships the split encoder/decoder export, which does not match the graph contract above. The artifact is produced locally by the committed recipe.
operator_steps: Run scripts/build-whisper-e2e-onnx.ps1 to produce the artifact.
The recipe prints the produced length and sha256 and rewrites this file plus WHISPER_TINY_INT8_ONNX_SHA256 and WHISPER_TINY_INT8_ONNX_LENGTH in crates/synapse-models/src/registry.rs.
Commit the updated pin as a reviewable supply-chain change, then re-run scripts/synapse-setup.ps1.

provenance.pinned_by: Microsoft Olive v0.8.0 commit 6ab9d8bb9284a89ccc87c63ca323c0f3386f6426 from openai/whisper-tiny.en; graph and known-WAV parity verified
provenance.note: Reproducible local build via the committed recipe. Component INT8 quantization precedes BeamSearch insertion; Transformers 4.42.4 is required because >=4.43 exports empty-decoding Whisper graphs.
